identifier.value: Digital Platform for Commercial Real Estate Financing

product.name: Digital Platform for Commercial Real Estate Financing
product.description: A platform offering access to financing options for commercial real estate projects, facilitating the connection between project developers/investors and lenders.

product.name: Intuitive Tools for Financing
product.description: Features tools designed to simplify, expedite, and reduce the cost of securing financing for real estate projects.

product.name: Transparency Throughout the Process
product.description: Ensures high levels of transparency and data protection, allowing users to focus on their projects with a solid foundation for business decisions.

product.name: Transaction Security
product.description: Covers senior and mezzanine financing for all common real estate asset classes, with financing volumes ideally between 5 million and 60 million EUR.

product.name: Digital User Experience
product.description: Aims to provide a seamless, borrower-centered digital experience, facilitating the fulfillment of lender requirements in the most convenient way.

identifier.value: Expertise in Innovative Financing, Digitalization, and Sustainability

product.name: Expertise in Innovative Financing, Digitalization, and Sustainability
product.description: Offers up-to-date articles and insights on innovative financing, digitalization, and sustainability in the real estate sector.
